blocks.en: Explores the biology of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, dengue virus replication, and how synthetic biology tools (genetic circuits, engineered bacteria, and ovitrap design) can support disease surveillance and prevention.
blocks.text: Explores the biology of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, dengue virus replication, and how synthetic biology tools (genetic circuits, engineered bacteria, and ovitrap design) can support disease surveillance and prevention.

植物逆境

blocks.en: Explores how climate change and environmental conditions can place plants under stress, from extreme heat and drought to diseases and other biological threats. Through hands-on activities, experiments, and interactive games, students learn how plants respond to stress and how synthetic biology can be used to understand and develop new approaches for protecting crops.
blocks.text: Explores how climate change and environmental conditions can place plants under stress, from extreme heat and drought to diseases and other biological threats. Through hands-on activities, experiments, and interactive games, students learn how plants respond to stress and how synthetic biology can be used to understand and develop new approaches for protecting crops.
blocks.zh: 探討氣候變遷與環境條件如何讓植物陷入逆境，從極端高溫、乾旱到病害與其他生物威脅。學生透過動手活動、實驗與互動遊戲，認識植物如何回應逆境，以及合成生物學可以如何用來理解逆境、開發保護作物的新方法。
